objectives.name: the pumping station
objectives.text: Down the drain main. Don't stop

objectives.name: the mall
objectives.text: Kick the grate and get out at the mall

radio.line: Folks, he's gone down the drain. Ha. I've been waiting all day to say that.
...don't stop on the low pipes. They come up through the drains. I watched them do it.

bail.line: Splat! Don't swallow any of that, Parker.
Oh, he's in it now. Literally.
Face first in the Silt! That'll stain.

combo.line: Good. Faster than them, that's all you need.
Oh, he's making them look slow. They're not slow!
That's it. Keep your feet out of the muck.
Folks, he's dancing with the Hollows. Don't try this at home. You don't have a home.
That's how you outrun them. Don't stop.
Look at him dance down there! Come on, crawlers, keep up.

kill.line: Okay, but don't stop for them.
Ooh, he's swatting crawlers! Plenty more where that came from.
One down! Out of... yeah, I don't know. Lots.

down.line: Dinner's... oh, he's up again. Well, they'll keep.
Up. They're slow, you're not. Act like it.
Down in the Silt! Folks, I'm not going down there to check.
You stopped. Never stop down there.

radio.line: Pipe's wide enough. Run the wall if you're brave.
Meridian Mall, folks! The arena! Parker, darling, you just walked into the main event.
